projects.name: Web app

items.title: Add password strength meter to sign-up
items.description:
Show how strong the chosen password is while the person types.

- Use the same rules as the server
- No third-party script

items.title: Fix avatar upload failing for large PNG files
items.description:
Uploading a PNG above 5 MB ends with a blank error.

**Steps**
1. Open profile
2. Choose a 6 MB PNG
3. Save

items.title: Research how teams use saved filters
items.description: Talk to five teams. What do they filter by every day, and what do they never use?

items.title: Design the empty state for the reports page
items.description: The page is blank for new teams. It should explain what will appear and how to get there.

items.title: Export invoices as CSV

items.title: Search does not find words with diacritics
items.description: Searching for `zolty` should find `żółty`.

items.title: Speed up the dashboard for accounts with many projects
items.description: Loading takes over four seconds with 80 projects. Find the slow queries first.

items.description: Three emails over the first week: welcome, first project, invite the team.

items.title: Add keyboard shortcut for assigning to me
items.description: Press `M` on a selected item to assign it to yourself.

items.title: Session expires while typing a long comment
items.description: The text is lost when the session ends. Keep a local draft.

items.title: Redesign the pricing page
items.description: Two plans, a comparison table, and the questions people ask most.

items.title: Migrate file storage to the new bucket
items.description: Copy, verify checksums, switch reads, then switch writes.

items.title: Show who is viewing an item
items.description: Small avatars of the people who have the item open right now.

items.title: Calendar view starts the week on the wrong day
items.description: It should follow the locale: Monday in Poland.

projects.name: Platform

items.title: Interview three churned customers
items.description: Why did they leave, and what did they move to?

items.title: Add rate limiting to the public API
items.description: Per token, with clear headers and a helpful error body.

items.title: Dark mode contrast is too low in tables
items.description: Row text fails AA on the dark background.

items.title: Allow reordering columns on the board
items.description: Drag a column header to move it; remember the order per person.

items.title: Document the webhook payloads
items.description: One page with every event, a sample body and how to verify the signature.

items.title: Design mobile navigation
items.description: Bottom bar with the four places people go most.

items.title: Clean up unused feature flags
items.description: Fourteen flags are fully rolled out. Remove them and the dead branches.

items.title: Notification emails arrive twice
items.description: Happens when an item is assigned and commented on in the same minute.

items.title: Add two-factor sign-in
items.description: TOTP first, recovery codes, a way for an admin to reset it.

pages.title: How we work
pages.body:
## Cycles

We plan every second Monday. Anything not started by then goes back to the backlog.

## Reviews

Every change is read by one other person before it is done.

pages.title: Release checklist
pages.body:
1. Changelog written
2. Migrations tried on a copy of production
3. Support told what changes
4. Rollback plan in the item

pages.title: Decision: one price per workspace
pages.body:
We charge per workspace, not per seat.

**Why:** small teams should not have to count people.

**Consequence:** large workspaces cost us more than they pay; we revisit at 50 members.
